description: WORK-BUDGET VOTE: a holder signs ONE advisory ballot on one proposal the house has published about how a discretionary program budget might be used. The ballot is advice to the house: it is nonbinding, it decides nothing, and it can never cover a site owner's consent, the safety or protections of a worker, a pay floor, regulated work or a term a person agreed to. One wallet is one signal (a wallet is not a person), a count is never weighted by NET, and no balance is read. You name the proposal's id and its hash (net_governance_status gives both), the letter of the option you choose, and your own statement advisory true, which is never assumed for you. You choose the ballot's id; the same id and the same terms read the ballot back. commit casts the ballot; withdraw ends your own ballot until the vote closes, even while the NET programs are stopped, and you can cast a new one until the vote closes. FREE, a signed statement, no fee, no gas. The program is built but held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together: until then a new ballot is refused before you sign, and a withdrawal only works on a ballot that exists. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing in it, and casts no ballot of its own. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Two refusals depend on this wallet's own records and are answered only when you submit, so prepare never says which wallet holds what: the wallet may already hold a ballot on this proposal, or the ballot id may already be in use with other terms. A withdrawal's prepare says the same for every ballot id, because no read shows a ballot: the door refuses an id that is not a ballot, or a ballot on a vote that has closed, only when you submit, before the signature is spent. A withdrawal by a wallet that did not cast the ballot is refused only after the signature is verified, which spends the signature. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_governance within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit casts a new ballot, or withdraw ends one you hold.

advisory.description: commit: true is YOUR statement that this vote is advice to the house, decides nothing and moves no money. It is never assumed for you.

optionId.description: commit: the letter of the option you choose. The proposal lists its options.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the holder's wallet. Address only, never a private key.

proposalId.description: commit: the id of a published proposal (net_governance_status lists them).

proposalSha256.description: commit: the 64-character lowercase hash of the proposal you read. A changed word changes the hash.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you ever read it back.

recordId.description: The ballot's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you cast; the same id and the same terms read the ballot back.

name: prepare_net_governance
title: Cast or withdraw your own advisory ballot on a published work-budget proposal (step 1 of 2)
